_note: DSH 桌面化/一键启动器收录。全部经 GitHub API 实时核实（star/license/平台/最近推送）。数据抓取自各项目 README，未编造。无 license 声明者如实标注 null。这不是 dsh 插件目录——它们是桌面壳/启动器，把 dsh web 装进原生窗口方便小白。

launchers.name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop
launchers.description_zh: 为 DSH 插件生态打造的现代化桌面端，macOS + Windows 双平台，官方 Discord 社区
launchers.description_en: A modern desktop client built for the DSH plugin ecosystem, on macOS and Windows, with an official Discord community

launchers.name: DeepSeek Harness EAC「揽尽万象」
launchers.description_zh: 揽尽万象：Windows 10/11 + Linux（pacman/deb/rpm/AppImage）全覆盖的桌面端，Linux 发行格式最全
launchers.description_en: EAC (Embracing All Creation): desktop client covering Windows 10/11 plus the widest range of Linux formats — pacman, deb, rpm, AppImage

launchers.name: DSH Desktop
launchers.description_zh: local-first 跨平台桌面壳，除官方 DeepSeek 模型外还支持主流第三方模型提供商
launchers.description_en: A local-first, cross-platform desktop shell that supports mainstream third-party model providers beyond the official DeepSeek models

launchers.name: DSH Desktop
launchers.description_zh: 把 @deepseek-ai/dsh 封装成开箱即用的 Windows 客户端，内置 Node.js + dsh，便携版可放 U 盘，国内提供 Gitee 分片下载
launchers.description_en: Wraps @deepseek-ai/dsh into a ready-to-use Windows client with Node.js + dsh bundled in. A portable build fits on a USB stick; Gitee split downloads provided for users in China
highlights_zh: 便携版可放 U 盘

launchers.name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop
launchers.description_zh: Tauri 桌面版，仅约 5MB，零环境配置：不用装 Node.js/pnpm/Docker，下载安装即用。Windows/macOS/Linux
launchers.description_en: A Tauri desktop build of only ~5MB with zero environment setup — no Node.js, pnpm or Docker needed. Download, install, go. Windows/macOS/Linux

launchers.name: Oh-DSH
launchers.description_zh: 一套 DSH runtime，Desktop、Web 与 TUI 三种开发体验，把 AI Agent、工作区、本地工具与插件生态带到你习惯的界面
launchers.description_en: One DSH runtime powering three experiences — Desktop, Web and TUI — bringing AI agents, workspaces, local tools and the plugin ecosystem to the interface you prefer
highlights_zh: 一套 runtime 三种形态

launchers.name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop App
launchers.description_zh: 建立在 DSH 之上的本地 AI 工作桌面，把 Session/Agent/Tool/Skill/MCP/插件 与项目、文件、Git Worktree、Canvas、Office 产物组织在同一个应用，另附二次元看板娘主题
launchers.description_en: A local AI work desktop on top of DSH, organizing Sessions, Agents, Tools, Skills, MCP and plugins alongside projects, files, Git worktrees, Canvas and Office artifacts — plus an anime waifu theme

launchers.name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop
launchers.description_zh: 极简、local-first 的跨平台桌面壳，提供官网与全平台安装包（dmg/exe/deb/AppImage）
launchers.description_en: A minimal, local-first, cross-platform desktop shell with an official website and installers for all platforms (dmg/exe/deb/AppImage)

launchers.name: dsh-launcher
launchers.description_zh: Windows 原生轻量启动器：双击即用不用敲命令，安装包仅约 1.4MB，不内置 dsh、缺失依赖按需补齐、不改动系统环境。克制——不加文件面板/内置终端，一切交给 dsh 插件
launchers.description_en: A lightweight native Windows launcher: double-click to use, no commands. The installer is only ~1.4MB; it doesn't bundle dsh, installs missing dependencies on demand and never touches your system environment. Deliberately minimal — no file panel or built-in terminal, left to dsh plugins

launchers.name: Deepseek-Harness-Desktop
launchers.description_zh: 基于官方 Web UI 的 Electron 桌面壳：不重做聊天界面，负责窗口/托盘/工作区/API Key/启动编排，支持第三方模型思考强度、自定义主题背景图、内置插件市场
launchers.description_en: An Electron shell over the official Web UI — it doesn't rebuild the chat, but handles window, tray, workspaces, API keys and launch orchestration. Adds reasoning-strength control for third-party models, custom themes/backgrounds and a built-in plugin market
highlights_zh: 官方 Web UI 外壳

launchers.name: DSHA（安卓启动器）
launchers.description_zh: 在安卓手机上跑 deepseek-harness 的一体化方案：内置 proot + Ubuntu rootfs，免 ROOT 免 Termux，分步安装、多源测速自选、内嵌 WebView 直接用 Web UI
launchers.description_en: An all-in-one way to run deepseek-harness on Android: built-in proot + Ubuntu rootfs, no ROOT and no Termux. Step-by-step install with multi-mirror speed tests, and an embedded WebView for the Web UI

launchers.name: dsh-desktop
launchers.description_zh: Tauri v2 原生桌面应用：本地启动 dsh web 后端，自带 node + dsh 用户什么都不用装，含菜单栏/系统托盘/窗口记忆/崩溃自愈/自动更新，后端仅绑定 127.0.0.1
launchers.description_en: A native Tauri v2 desktop app: starts the dsh web backend locally and bundles its own node + dsh so end users install nothing. Menu bar, system tray, window-state memory, self-healing backend and in-app auto-update; the backend binds to 127.0.0.1 only

launchers.name: DSH Launcher
launchers.description_zh: Tauri 2 桌面启动器：浏览器式标签页承载 dsh WebUI，支持多标签/拖拽分屏/跨窗并入，集成插件商店目录与配置编辑，端口被占用时自动沿用已有服务
launchers.description_en: A Tauri 2 launcher hosting dsh WebUI in browser-style tabs: multi-tab, drag-to-split and cross-window merging. Integrates the plugin-store catalog and config editing, and reuses an already-running dsh service when the port is taken
launchers.platform_note_zh: release 现仅提供 Windows 安装包（Tauri 源码本身跨平台）
launchers.platform_note_en: Release currently ships Windows installers only (the Tauri source itself is cross-platform)

launchers.name: DSH Launcher
launchers.description_zh: 最方便的 DSH 启动器兼第三方插件管理：Electron + React + Tailwind，一键安装运行环境、快捷 API 切换（类 cc-switch）、客户端内嵌 Web、插件市场与余额小部件，可离线部署
launchers.description_en: The most convenient DSH launcher and third-party plugin manager: Electron + React + Tailwind. One-click environment install, quick API switching (cc-switch style), in-app Web, a plugin market and a balance widget; offline deployment supported

launchers.name: dsh-launcher
launchers.description_zh: 给小白用的傻瓜式 DSH 管理工具：图形化管理插件（安装/更新/修复依赖/启停），三维更新看板，自动装 Node.js，环境检测一目了然，README 提供 5 种语言
launchers.description_en: A beginner-friendly, no-CLI DSH manager: visually manage plugins (install/update/fix-deps/toggle), a 3-way update board, auto Node.js install, at-a-glance environment detection. README in 5 languages

launchers.name: DSH-Web Desktop
launchers.description_zh: 双击即用：把 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 装进原生 Windows 窗口，从源码到工作台一步到位
launchers.description_en: One double-click from DeepSeek Harness source to a native Windows workspace — wraps the Web UI in a native window

launchers.name: dsh-旋律启动器
launchers.description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面启动器与插件管理器：下载即用，管理 DSH 本体、插件、API Key 与运行配置，无需预装 Node.js。Electron + React + TypeScript + Vite
launchers.description_en: A Windows desktop launcher and plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness: download and use, managing the DSH core, plugins, API keys and runtime config without pre-installed Node.js. Electron + React + TypeScript + Vite

launchers.name: DSH Launcher
launchers.description_zh: 一键部署与管理 DSH 的 Windows 桌面工具：开箱即用、免管理员权限、卸载零残留，向导式安装 Node.js 与 DSH，图形化启停/端口/日志，版本一键升降级
launchers.description_en: A Windows desktop tool to deploy and manage DSH with one click: ready out of the box, no admin privileges, zero-residue uninstall. Wizard-style Node.js + DSH install, graphical start/stop/port/logs, one-click version up/downgrade

launchers.name: DSH Desktop for Linux
launchers.description_zh: Linux 用户的桌面版启动器：Electron 窗口内嵌 dsh Web UI，自动管理 dsh 服务进程，提供系统托盘、设置面板与更新检测，支持 deb/AppImage 安装
launchers.description_en: A Linux desktop launcher: an Electron window embedding the dsh Web UI. Auto-manages the dsh service process, with system tray, settings panel and update detection; installable as deb/AppImage
